Story time:

I used to work with a lady who worked for Rentokil, a supplier of pest control products. She visited this guy in a takeaway shop who used standard mouse traps. She sold him a supply of the sticky mouse paper as an alternative and he seemed to really like it. A couple of months go by and she phones the guy to see how he is going, and he says that he loves the sticky mouse paper, but doesn't need to order any more at the moment. Another couple of months go by and she is thinking that he might need some more so she rings him again and he says nope, all good.

One day she is in the area so decides to stop in at his shop. Enough time has passed that he should have well and truly used up the supply that she sold him initially. When she arrives he says he loves the stuff that she sold him. She mentions that he should have used up what she sold him in the beginning.

He says "Really? They still have lots of space left on them, come, take a look" They go over to one of the traps and she sees all these little black things scattered on it. On closer inspection, she sees that they are........mouse legs.

The guy was letting the mice get trapped then using a pair of scissors, he would snip off their legs, throw the bodies away and keep using the trap.
